verdict.rationale: Incremental rollout is a fair question for a deployment platform, but the evidence pack never documents canary releases, percentage-based traffic splitting, or staged rollouts. The nearest features are one-click rollback and Deploy Previews. These are adjacent controls: they recover from a bad deploy or review it before release, but they do not shift live traffic gradually to limit blast radius.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can roll out new deployments incrementally to reduce blast radius
